source.title: WebKit Licensing
source.summary: WebKit documents that inherited KHTML code can be LGPL, newly contributed code uses BSD-2-Clause, and an existing file’s license depends on that file; moved code keeps its original copyright/license notice.

applicationToNeAntik: Do not infer one license for every bundled WebKit image/resource from the repository-level license or a nearby file. Keep all candidate notice applicability decisions unresolved unless the exact runtime source file or upstream license metadata supports the decision.
